title: U.S. Gold Corp. to Present at Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference :: U.S. Gold Corp. (USAU)
body_markdown:
**Chairman, Mr. Luke Norman to Present at 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time on September 9** **th** **, 2026**


CHEYENNE, Wyo.


, Aug. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- U.S. Gold Corp. ("U.S. Gold," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us") (Nasdaq: USAU) will present at the Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference being held Wednesday – Thursday, September 9 - 10, 2026, at the Westin New York Grand Central hotel, in Manhattan, New York. The presentation will be webcast and can be viewed via the[Moody Capital Solutions conference website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760551-1&h=225129704&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmoodycapital.com%2Fconference%2F&a=Moody+Capital+Solutions+conference+website) once the event begins.


Mr. Luke Norman, Chairman, will deliver the Company's presentation and conduct in-person one-on-one meetings throughout the conference.


For in person attendance of the conference please:[Click here to register](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760551-1&h=1720905019&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_139861%2Finvestor_reg_new.html%3Fattendee_role_id%3DMOODY_INVESTOR&a=Click+here+to+register) .


**About the Company** U.S. Gold Corp. is a publicly traded, U.S. focused gold and copper exploration and development company. U.S. Gold Corp. has a portfolio of exploration properties. The Company's CK Gold Project is located in Southeast Wyoming and has a Feasibility Study technical report, which was completed by Halyard-Micon International, Inc. The Company's Keystone exploration property is on the Cortez Trend in Nevada. The Company's Challis Gold Project is located in Idaho. For more information about U.S. Gold Corp., please visit[https://www.usgoldcorp.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760551-1&h=1278701754&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4708120-1%26h%3D3480203071%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fedge.prnewswire.com%252Fc%252Flink%252F%253Ft%253D0%2526l%253Den%2526o%253D4660289-1%2526h%253D967527427%2526u%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%25252F%2526a%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%25252F%26a%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%252F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%2F) .
